tool_input.command:
bash -n rotate.sh && bash -n verify.sh && bash -n lib/common.sh && echo "syntax ok"
t=$(mktemp -d); t=$(cd "$t" && pwd -P)
mkdir -p "$t/src"
printf 'v\n' > "$t/src/f.txt"
for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000 20260104-000000; do
  BACKUP_STAMP=$s bash backup.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name "my backup" "$t/src" >/dev/null
done
echo "--- dry-run, keep 2:"
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name "my backup" --keep 2 --dry-run
echo "--- real, keep 2:"
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name "my backup" --keep 2
ls "$t/dest" | grep -v sha256
echo "--- sidecars left:"
ls "$t/dest" | grep sha256
echo "--- verify with --name filter:"
bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name "my backup"; echo "rc=$?"
printf 'x' >> "$t/dest/my backup-20260104-000000.tar.gz"
echo "--- verify corrupted spaced archive:"
bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest"; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- help/unknown-flag/keep-validation:"
bash rotate.sh --help >/dev/null; echo "help rc=$?"
bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name x --keep 0; echo "keep0 rc=$?"
bash verify.sh --bogus 2>&1 | tail -1
rm -rf "$t"
tool_input.description: Manually exercise refactored rotate.sh and verify.sh edge cases

result:
Done. All 9 tests pass (`bash tests/run_tests.sh` → "all tests passed"), the rotation now deletes only the oldest surplus archives (and keeps all N when exactly N exist), and verify.sh handles spaces in sidecar file names — the extra manual checks confirmed dry-run, sidecar removal, `--name` filtering, BAD/rc=2 on corruption, and all flag forms (`--flag value`, `--flag=value`, `-q`, `-n`, `-h`, unknown-option rejection) still behave identically in both scripts.

Notes on the fixes:
- **rotate.sh**: `surplus()` used `tail -n +"$keep"` on an oldest-first list, i.e. it deleted the *newest* entries, and the early exit used `-lt`, letting `total == keep` through (which is what deleted the newest archive with exactly N backups). Now: early exit on `-le`, and surplus is `head -n $((total - keep))` — the oldest.
- **verify.sh**: the sidecar line was split with `awk '{print $2}'`, truncating names at the first space. Now `read -r expected file` keeps the whole remainder of the line intact; the digest comparison is also quoted.
- **New `lib/common.sh`**: contains the shared option-parsing block (with a default `parse_local_option` stub for scripts without private flags), the `--keep` validation, and `resolve_dir`; `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` source it with `"$@"` and keep their `usage()` and flags unchanged. `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` were left untouched.

A leftover helper script I used for manual checks is at `/tmp/sfk-bktk-check.sh` (its data dir self-deleted); delete it whenever you like.

Changed files: rotate.sh, verify.sh, tests/run_tests.sh, and the new lib/common.sh.
